key_points: Adobe launched new AI tools in Acrobat enhancing PDF interactivity and workflows.
Analysts note ADBE could be ~22% undervalued based on AI-driven growth prospects.
CEO Shantanu Narayen sold $31.3M of shares for tax/estate planning, retaining significant holdings.
Recent price slump (~59% over 5 years) has sparked valuation bargain discussions.
Market commentary shows mixed sentiment with AI stocks broadly volatile.
